title: Algerian Tagine Stew
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew made with tofu, algerian spices, and acrid notes, perfect for a warm and comforting meal.

ingredients.name: Algerian spice mix
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

ingredients.name: Acrid spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 4 minutes.
Add the algerian spice mix and acrid spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tofu and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
